name: Cylde
source:
His life goal is to avoid working and to run away from troublesome fluffs and things. He's lazy and unprofessional. Despite being a guard like Loria, the only work he doesn't hate doing is being a tour guide in Cemetery. 

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/fluffness/fluffland]Kickstarter[/url]]
